span.div:
1. Broker-3 (controller) crashes
2. ZooKeeper session timeout (6s default)
expires
3. /controller ephemeral znode deleted
4. All brokers notified (watch on /controller)
5. Broker 1 creates /controller → becomes new
controller
6. New controller rebuilds partition
leadership from scratch

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
- Watch /brokers/ids for broker failures
- Assign partition leaders when brokers join
or leave
- Update ISR (in-sync replica) sets
- Manage topic creation and deletion
- Watch /admin for admin operations
